title: Thread-Safe LRU-TTL Cache with Atomic Eviction Invariants
failure_mode: Race conditions during concurrent TTL expiration, wall-clock time drift traps, and corrupting LRU ordering on expired key lookups
invariant_guarantee: Strict monotonic time tracking, O(1) atomic eviction under high thread contention, zero mutation-during-iteration errors, and prioritization of expired items over valid LRU items during capacity eviction
